Name: Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes Cometkins Style
Author: Chocoronron
Description:
This mod uses edited sprites from ZoeyHoshi's original mod and the various visual mods Cometkins made. The only original thing I drew is the yellow dandelion flower for the vanilla dandelion crop sprite.

Like the original mod, there are two different versions each for the daffodil and dandelion crop growth sprites. There is the original version, which recolors ZoeyHoshi's original sprites so that they have the same color as Cometkins's sprites. Then there is the vanilla version, which uses Cometkins's original sprites as the basis for the crop growth phases. You can choose whichever style you'd like, regardless of the option you chose in ZoeyHoshi's original mod. This mod will simply overwrite the original textures.

Please report any errors you find, and I'll try to fix them immediately. God bless, and have a blessed day!
